evidence: Completed file-level provenance review of src/Grid.Mo2/**. Normalized whole-file comparisons against the five frozen MO2/usvfs/Vortex/FOMOD upstreams produced zero normalized whole-file matches. Targeted structural review of Mo2BsaIndexParser.cs against ModOrganizer2/modorganizer-bsatk@c42a252797041fa245573f367ef098569f5de5c3 identified shared BSA-format facts/constraints but no meaningful implementation correspondence. Frozen-source investigation identified no upstream PEX/Papyrus parser implementation target for Mo2PapyrusInspectionService.cs. Other reviewed files were resolved as interoperability/functional similarity or no identified upstream source correspondence. No copied or adapted upstream source material was identified. Zero matches are comparison evidence and are not treated as proof of independent authorship.
entries.requiredAction: No further upstream-source comparison required for the reviewed src/Grid.Mo2/** scope absent a new concrete provenance trigger.
